focus: Practical software engineering, scientific research tools, and automation across sectors
title: When “Close Enough” Breaks a Data Model
utility_use_case: A research team maintains a shared directory of microscopy images and processed exports. Before archiving a release, an engineer runs `bash duplicate-report.sh --root ./assets` to identify byte-identical files and estimate potentially redundant storage. The report helps the team focus a manual review, while leaving decisions about provenance, retention, and cleanup to maintainers.
